_readme: EVB Lite protocol profile, filled in from the physical sensor EVBS_V1F9L on 2026-11-10.
Record mode: ARM TEST sets the sensor's maximum recording time (Operator -> Analysis ->
'EVB Lite: max test length') and sends the portal's Record request; STOP TEST sends the
portal's Stop request and the sensor returns the recording as CSV.
Evidence: docs/evb-lite-evidence/ and the portal script /js/index.js (inspected, not stored).
verified_by: Operator capture of sensor EVBS_V1F9L (HAR + recording), profile written with Claude Code
source_of_truth: Sensor portal traffic docs/evb-lite-evidence/portal-record-2026-11-10.har, recording docs/evb-lite-evidence/EVBS_V1F9L_2026-11-10_16-58-48_90.csv and the portal script http://<sensor>/js/index.js (2026-11-10); EVident Vibration Sensor User Manual §6

status._comment: GET /status, used by the portal for battery, firmware and host name.

record._comment: GET /start?format=csv redirects to port 8000, records until the sensor's recording time is over or GET /stop is sent, then returns the CSV. /progress returns {"progress": 0-100} while recording and HTTP 400 when idle. /csv downloads the last recording. Portal script functions: handleStartButton, handleUniversalStop, downloadCsv, fetchAllSettingsOnce, bindDurationAutoSubmit.
record.documented_in: EVident Vibration Sensor User Manual §6.3 (Record); request observed in the sensor portal's own traffic, docs/evb-lite-evidence/portal-record-2026-11-10.har

stop.documented_in: EVident Vibration Sensor User Manual §6.2 (Stop button); portal script /js/index.js handleUniversalStop

settings._comment: Read-only GET /settings: {accel, gyro, temp, odr, accel_range, gyro_range, duration, gravity_comp}.

set_duration.documented_in: EVident Vibration Sensor User Manual §6.1 (recording time); portal script /js/index.js bindDurationAutoSubmit (POST /duration?value=<s>)

live._comment: Display-only live view: the portal's own stream (wsConnect / handleStartButton in /js/index.js). ws://<sensor>:81/, send START/STOP, one JSON sample per message {"t": <us>, "ax", "ay", "az"}. Measurements always come from the recording.
live.documented_in: portal script /js/index.js wsConnect (ws://<host>:81/, START/STOP, JSON {t, ax, ay, az})

samples._comment: Format of the recording. Timestamp = microseconds since the recording started (570 us steps observed); Accel_* = m/s2 (resting magnitude 9.67 m/s2).

_axis_map_comment: Lying flat label up, the sensor reads Z = -9.66 m/s2, so z is inverted to make +z read +1 g at rest. Assumes the sensor is mounted label up in the lander; X/Y signs are not yet checked (six-face test, docs/evb-lite-integration.md §7).
